posts.author: PrettyMans
posts.body:
Hey Guys!
I don't know if this is the right forum to put this under. My mom bought me RPG Maker MV a while ago when the old RPG Maker website was still in use. I've been trying to find my license key from then but can't figure out how to get it since the website is gone. I've been away from here for a while so I did not see when the site was closing down.
I've tried emailing support, but I've gotten no answer. I'm not sure what else to do.

posts.author: Sirius270
posts.body: You (or your mom) should've received an email with that information after purchasing. It will be there, if you can find the email. Good luck!

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
PrettyMans said:
I've tried emailing support, but I've gotten no answer.
Click to expand...
Emailing support is the correct way, but due to Degica being a small company it can take a few business days to get an answer. How long ago did you email them, and more importantly who/where did you send the message?
It needs to go to sales support, not technical support, from the links above this forum.

posts.body: I know it's not realeted but if you couldn't find the key or get the help, there's like 85% discount on Steam for RMMV now.
